name: pnpm
desc: Content-addressed store with hard links, so one copy of each package on disk. Use for monorepos and CI where install time and disk actually cost money.

name: npm
desc: Ships with Node, works everywhere, no setup. Use when you want zero decisions and no extra install step.

name: Yarn
desc: Workspaces, Plug-n-Play and patch support. Use in existing repos already standardised on it.

name: uv
desc: Rust-fast Python package and project manager replacing pip, venv and poetry. Use in every new Python project.

name: Poetry
desc: Dependency resolution and packaging for Python with a lockfile. Use in projects that already depend on it.

name: Docker
desc: Packages an app with its dependencies so it runs the same everywhere. Use when the app needs more than one process or a specific system library.

name: Podman
desc: Daemonless rootless containers, Docker-compatible CLI. Use where a root daemon is not allowed.

name: Docker Compose
desc: Declares multi-container local environments in one YAML file. Use for local dev with a database and a cache alongside the app.

name: Kubernetes
desc: Schedules containers across machines with self-healing and rollouts. Use when you genuinely run many services on many nodes, not before.

name: Helm
desc: Templated, versioned Kubernetes manifests. Use once you paste the same YAML into a third environment.

name: Argo CD
desc: GitOps controller that reconciles the cluster to what git says. Use when the repo must be the only source of truth.

name: GitHub Actions
desc: CI wired directly into the repository with a huge marketplace. Use whenever the code already lives on GitHub.

name: GitLab CI
desc: Pipelines, registry and environments in one product. Use in self-managed GitLab installations.

name: Jenkins
desc: Self-hosted automation server with a plugin for everything. Use where builds must run inside your own network.

name: CircleCI
desc: Hosted CI with strong caching and parallelism. Use for big test suites that need to finish fast.

name: Terraform
desc: Declarative infrastructure with a state file and plan step. Use so nobody creates production resources by clicking.

name: OpenTofu
desc: Open-source Terraform fork under the Linux Foundation. Use when the BSL licence is a problem.

name: Pulumi
desc: Infrastructure defined in real programming languages. Use when loops and abstractions in HCL start hurting.

name: Ansible
desc: Agentless configuration management over SSH. Use to configure servers you already have rather than create new ones.

name: Vercel
desc: Git-push hosting with preview URLs and edge functions. Use for Next.js and frontend-heavy apps you want live in minutes.

name: Netlify
desc: Static hosting with functions, forms and split testing. Use for marketing sites and Jamstack builds.

name: Railway
desc: Deploys containers and managed databases from a repo with almost no config. Use for side projects and internal tools.

name: Render
desc: Managed web services, workers and cron with Postgres included. Use as a simpler Heroku replacement.

name: Fly.io
desc: Runs containers close to users in many regions. Use when latency worldwide matters but Kubernetes does not.

name: Coolify
desc: Self-hosted PaaS on your own VPS, Heroku-style. Use when you want push-to-deploy without a per-seat bill.

name: AWS
desc: Every primitive you could need, and a bill to match. Use when compliance, scale or existing commitments point there.

name: Google Cloud
desc: Strong data, ML and Kubernetes story. Use when BigQuery or GKE is the centre of the architecture.

name: Microsoft Azure
desc: Deep Active Directory, Office and .NET integration. Use in enterprises already paying Microsoft.

name: Hetzner
desc: Cheap dedicated and cloud servers in Europe. Use when you are happy to run things yourself for a tenth of the price.

name: DigitalOcean
desc: Simple droplets, managed databases and app platform. Use when AWS complexity is not worth it.

name: Cloudflare
desc: CDN, DNS, WAF and Workers at the edge. Use in front of almost any site for caching and protection.

name: Fastly
desc: Programmable CDN with instant purge. Use for high-traffic media sites needing precise cache control.

name: NGINX
desc: Reverse proxy, TLS termination and static file serving. Use in front of self-hosted apps.

name: Caddy
desc: Reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS certificates. Use when you want TLS to be one line of config.

name: HashiCorp Vault
desc: Secret storage with dynamic credentials and audit logs. Use when secrets must rotate and every read is recorded.

name: Doppler
desc: Syncs environment variables across environments and platforms. Use to stop passing .env files around in chat.

name: Infisical
desc: Open-source secret management you can self-host. Use when secrets cannot sit with a third party.
